items.title: JPMorgan sees $450B in AI bond issuance in 2027
items.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan Chase & Co. expects companies to raise $450 billion through investment-grade bond markets in 2027 to fund artificial intelligence capital expenditures, up from $368 billion in global investment-grade bond issuance for AI-focused companies this year.
